hook: HPV Now Drives Most Oral Cancer Cases
caption: Most people still think oral cancer is mainly a smoker's disease. It's not anymore. HPV is now responsible for roughly 70% of oral cancers, yet only about 1 in 4 adults knows that connection exists. The fastest-growing group being diagnosed is adults between 35 and 55, many of whom have never touched a cigarette. That gap between the reality of the disease and what people actually know about it is where the real danger lives. The good news is that oral cancer caught early is highly treatable. A free, two-minute risk screener at oralcheck.org is a straightforward place to start.
